scenes.a_nursery: 1955 San Francisco hospital nursery at night: a newborn baby boy wrapped in a white blanket lying alone in a small hospital bassinet, a nurse's silhouette at the doorway, soft lamp light, quiet and lonely mood
scenes.a_father: 1950s Wisconsin farmhouse living room: a stern, ill elderly German-American father in an armchair with a blanket over his knees, pointing sharply toward the door, his young adult daughter standing before him in tears

scenes.a_unsigned: Close-up of 1950s adoption papers on a wooden desk with a fountain pen lying untouched beside them, a young woman's hand hovering hesitantly above, tense quiet mood, papers show only illegible scribble lines

scenes.a_paul_engine: 1950s: a muscular young mechanic with tattoos on his forearms and slicked-back hair, resembling a 1950s film star, working on a car engine under the open hood in a small San Francisco garage, wrench in hand, confident and gentle face
scenes.a_clara_ledger: 1950s office: a kind dark-haired Armenian-American woman in her thirties working as a bookkeeper at a wooden desk, writing neatly in large ledger books with an adding machine beside her, warm lamp light

scenes.b_fight: Late 1960s middle school yard: a crowd of teenagers circled around two boys fighting, dust rising, a younger skinny boy watching from the edge with alarm, dramatic angle

scenes.c_cabinet_back: Close-up of a craftsman's weathered hands carefully sanding the hidden back panel of a handmade wooden cabinet turned around on a workbench, fine wood grain, dust in warm light

scenes.c_junkyard: 1960s auto junkyard on a weekend: a muscular 1960s mechanic father with tattooed forearms and slicked-back dark hair and a skinny dark-haired boy of about eight searching through piles of old car parts, carburetors and generators, stacked wrecked cars, dusty sunlight

scenes.c_carflip: 1960s driveway: a muscular 1960s mechanic father with tattooed forearms and slicked-back dark hair under the hood of an old two-tone 1960 Ford Falcon sedan, freshly polished, a satisfied smile, the boy handing him a wrench

scenes.c_carpenter: A beautiful handmade wooden dresser pulled away from the wall showing that even its hidden back panel is made of fine polished hardwood, warm workshop light, craftsmanship
scenes.d_driveway: 1960s suburban driveway: a friendly middle-aged engineer neighbor kneeling beside a carbon microphone, a car battery and a loudspeaker laid on the concrete, a skinny dark-haired boy of about eight speaking into the microphone, astonished as his voice comes out loud
scenes.d_run_home: a skinny dark-haired boy of about eight running excitedly across front lawns of a 1960s Eichler-style suburban street toward his house, afternoon sun

scenes.d_visit: 1960s neighbor's driveway: a muscular 1960s mechanic father with tattooed forearms and slicked-back dark hair and a skinny dark-haired boy of about eight standing over a carbon microphone, battery and speaker, the father staring at the speaker with a sheepish embarrassed look, the engineer neighbor smiling
scenes.d_alone: Night in a modest 1960s bedroom: a skinny dark-haired boy of about eight sitting alone on his bed hugging his knees, looking out the window at the suburban street, thoughtful and lonely, warm light from the hallway
scenes.d_parents_watch: 1960s home at night: a mechanic father and a kind dark-haired mother looking through a half-open bedroom door at their son tinkering with electronics on his desk, worried but devoted expressions
scenes.e_reading: 1950s kitchen table: a kind dark-haired mother teaching a small dark-haired boy of about five to read from a picture book, finger under the words, morning light
scenes.e_bored: Early 1960s elementary school classroom: rows of children at desks copying from the blackboard, one dark-haired boy at the back slumped and bored, staring out the window, a teacher writing

scenes.e_bikelocks: Early 1960s school bike rack: two mischievous boys secretly switching combination locks between bicycles, looking around to see if anyone notices

scenes.e_father_school: Early 1960s principal's office: a muscular 1960s mechanic father with tattooed forearms and slicked-back dark hair in a work shirt sitting calmly but firmly across from a stern female teacher, his small son sitting on a bench beside him

scenes.e_studying: 1960s boy's bedroom at night: a dark-haired boy of about nine happily solving pages of math problems at a small desk under a lamp, a giant lollipop leaning beside him

scenes.f_explorers: Late 1960s corporate cafeteria in the evening: a Hewlett-Packard style engineer giving a talk with an oscilloscope on the table to about fifteen eager teenagers sitting at cafeteria tables, a lanky dark-haired teen in the front row, no logos
scenes.f_phonebook: 1960s kitchen: a lanky dark-haired American teenage boy of about fifteen with a mop of hair flipping through a thick telephone directory, finger stopping on a line, determined look, a wall-mounted rotary phone beside him
scenes.f_phone: 1960s kitchen: a lanky dark-haired American teenage boy of about fifteen with a mop of hair nervously but boldly talking on a wall-mounted rotary telephone, twisting the cord, eyes wide
scenes.f_exec_phone: 1960s elegant Palo Alto home study in the evening: a friendly silver-haired executive in a cardigan answering a rotary telephone with an amused smile, bookshelves and electronic instruments around him

scenes.f_donuts: Late 1960s engineering office upstairs at 10am: engineers in short-sleeve shirts and ties around a table with boxes of donuts and coffee cups, a lanky dark-haired American teenage boy of about fifteen with a mop of hair happily joining them holding a donut
scenes.g_haltek: Late 1960s huge cluttered electronics surplus warehouse: towering shelves and open bins overflowing with old radios, tubes and parts, a fenced yard in the back holding grey military submarine control panels with big toggle switches and amber and red knobs, a lanky dark-haired teen worker with a clipboard

scenes.g_collect_call: Late 1960s high school hallway payphone: a lanky dark-haired American teenage boy of about fifteen with a mop of hair making a call with a sly confident grin, cupping the receiver, students walking past
scenes.g_parcel: Late 1960s high school electronics classroom: an air-mail parcel being opened on a lab bench revealing a special electronic component, a Tesla coil and tools in the background
scenes.g_teacher: Late 1960s high school electronics classroom: a stern former navy pilot teacher with a crew cut glaring angrily, holding a small electronic part, while a lanky dark-haired American teenage boy of about fifteen with a mop of hair shrugs with a defiant smile
